# Quality Home Improvement Experts LLC

> General contracting & remodeling based in Killeen, Texas. Quality Home Improvement Experts rebuilds storm-damaged homes, replaces roofs, adds rooms and builds patios and fences. Reviewers say Julio calls back fast and explains every step.

- Phone: (254) 462-2477
- Based in: Killeen, TX
- Service area: Killeen, Harker Heights, Copperas Cove, Temple, Belton, Nolanville
- Google rating: 4.9 from 40 reviews

## Services
- Roofing & storm damage: New roofs and repairs after hail and tornado damage, with trim and paint to finish.
- Kitchen & bath remodels: Kitchens, bathrooms and whole-room renovations, from leak repair to new finishes.
- Additions & garages: Room additions and new garages, framed, roofed and finished to match the house.
- Covered patios & pavilions: Gabled patio covers, backyard pavilions and patios with outdoor kitchens.
- Fences & gates: Cedar privacy fences, modern horizontal fences, metal and iron fences, and drive gates.
- Concrete, floors & doors: Driveway extensions and patios, tile and laminate floors, and new doors and windows.

## About
Quality Home Improvement Experts LLC is a Killeen general contractor with an office at 1501 E Rancier Ave, open Monday to Friday from 8 to 5. Julio is the main point of contact on most jobs, working alongside team members Ruben and Diego, and the team speaks Spanish. One family whose home was hit by the May 22, 2024 tornado says Julio and Ruben came out, explained exactly what they would do and got them back home quickly. Another needed a new roof after May hail storms. Reviews also cover a house extension, a driveway extension, new doors, a ceiling leak and mold repair, and an attic ladder replacement backed by a warranty.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you repair storm and hail damage in Killeen?
  A: Yes. The team repaired a home hit by the May 22, 2024 tornado and has replaced roofs after May hail storms.
- Q: Can you build a room addition?
  A: Yes. Customers have hired the company for house extensions and additions, and say they are kept up to date on each step.
- Q: Who will I be talking to?
  A: Usually Julio, who customers describe as their consistent point of contact from the estimate to the finished job.
- Q: Do you speak Spanish?
  A: Yes, se habla español.
- Q: Are estimates free, and is the work warrantied?
  A: Yes. Estimates are free, and customers mention a warranty on work such as an attic ladder replacement.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: The Killeen office at 1501 E Rancier Ave is open Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM.
